name: Single Arm Iso Row
instructions: Sit at the machine with your chest against the pad.
Hold one handle with a neutral grip.
Pull the handle toward your torso.
longevityNotes: Pulling strength balances all the forward-reaching of daily life and protects the shoulders and upper back. A strong back is one of the best predictors of staying active and independent.
overview: A single-arm row with an isolateral machine that lets each side work independently.
